parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Enables or disables this {{object}} instance. This parameter is based on ''ifAdminStatus'' from {{bibref|RFC2863}}.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: This parameter describes the type of {{object}} for this object instance. The timing of the event occurrence is adjusted based on the value of the {{param|RandomnessSpread}} parameter. {{enum}}

parameters.name: RandomnessSpread
parameters.description: The spread, in {{units}}, of the Uniform Discrete random distribution algorithm. A value of 0 means that the random algorithm is not applied.

parameters.name: CycleInterval
parameters.description: The duration of the time interval, in {{units}}, that used to calculate cycle numbers.

object.description: This object defines the information associated with an event used within the measurement agent. Event instances may be referenced by various objects within the LMAP model.
